name: Ghost Hunting
overview: Scripture warns believers against seeking familiar spirits or wizards, as doing so defiles and leads away from God’s truth (Leviticus 19:31). The Bible reveals a spiritual battle against unseen forces of darkness (Ephesians 6:12), contrasting the unclean spirits that wander seeking rest (Matthew 12:43) with the indwelling and guidance of the Holy Spirit given to believers (Luke 4:1; John 1:33; Hebrews 6:4). True spiritual power and peace come from the Holy Ghost, not from attempting to contact or hunt ghosts, which Scripture condemns.
